ExtraDock 4.2.6 – Share, Backup & Rock Solid! 🚀🔒

✨ What's New

  • One-Click Share to DockShare.io: A share button on each dock's detail view uploads it directly to the community gallery — show off your dock setup with one tap!
  • Full Backup Export & Import: New Import / Export settings tab writes a .extradockbackup of your whole setup that you can restore anywhere — never lose your perfect dock again!

⚡ Improvements

  • Widget Picker Close Button: The widget picker now has a close button for easier dismissal!

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • LiveDock Icon Fix: Fixed wrong icons for apps with duplicate bundle IDs or after reinstalling to a different location — now identifies apps by path first!
  • Screen Assignment Stability: Screen assignments no longer break when a monitor briefly disconnects or Mac goes to sleep!
  • Space Awareness Deduplication: The widget now suppresses apps you've already pinned to your dock manually — no more duplicates!
  • Space Awareness Permission Handling: The widget now clears itself when Accessibility permission is missing — no more stale or partial data!

🚀 What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraDock more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraDock community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
